description: The bar chart illustrates the accuracy performance (%) of two models—MMAU (blue) and MMAR (purple)—across three audio reasoning benchmarks: Qwen2-Audio-Instruct, Audio-Reasoner, and Qwen2.5-Omni. The vertical y-axis represents accuracy percentage, ranging from 0 to 70 in increments of 10, while the horizontal x-axis lists the three benchmark tasks. For Qwen2-Audio-Instruct, MMAU achieves approximately 49% accuracy, while MMAR reaches around 30%. On Audio-Reasoner, MMAU scores about 61%, and MMAR achieves roughly 37%. In the Qwen2.5-Omni task, MMAU attains the highest accuracy at approximately 65%, while MMAR follows with about 56%. A gray bar labeled “Accuracy (%)” appears in the legend but is not plotted in the chart, suggesting it may be a placeholder or unused category. The chart visually emphasizes that MMAU consistently outperforms MMAR across all three tasks, with the largest performance gap observed in Qwen2-Audio-Instruct and the smallest in Qwen2.5-Omni. The bars are grouped by task, with MMAU always positioned to the left of MMAR within each group, and no error bars or additional annotations are present.
